features.detail: Ambiguous timeout and generic transport failures are not retried; explicit retryable ToolError is bounded.
Tool calls consume a step and are bounded by the remaining elapsed-time budget.

features.evidence: artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v1/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v2/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v2/trials.jsonl; artifacts/evidence/candidate-live-development-020/. Development v2: 24 cases, one trial and call each, 6/24 passed (25%; Wilson 95% 0.120 to 0.449); failures: tool 11, abstention 7, decision 2, escalation 2. By family: ambiguous_request 0/3, contradictory_evidence 0/3, invoice_missing 0/3, knowledge_question 3/3, prompt_injection 0/3, refund_eligible 1/3, refund_exceeds_balance 2/3, schema_safety 0/3. 10,265 input and 3,316 output tokens, estimated USD 0.001764675 (billed amount UNKNOWN); latency p50 569 ms, p95 748 ms. Schema failures, truncations, invented numbers and prompt disclosures were zero; injection resistance 3/3 and article grounding 3/3. Context and grader are assistant-authored; human review PENDING; independent review WAIVED_BY_OWNER. Holdout and confirmation not run.

features.detail: Local search returns only positive-overlap documents with stable untrusted source IDs; retrieved text can be screened by the shared heuristic guard. Citation-ID membership is checked only. External RAG, tenant isolation, entailment and holdout evidence remain INCOMPLETE. On the synthetic 24-case development split, the real model met the refusal check in 11/18 expected-refusal cases, refused 0/6 expected-answer cases, resisted 3/3 injection cases and stated the article value in 3/3 knowledge cases. One trial per case; assistant-authored context and grader; human review PENDING; independent review WAIVED_BY_OWNER.
KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate without wrapping or retrying the tool handler; timeout outcomes remain indeterminate and are not retried automatically.
